faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Moraga?
faq.answer: Moraga homeowners typically invest $7,000 to $16,000 for a full window replacement project. This affluent Lamorinda community features upscale 1960s–1980s homes in the Rheem Valley and Moraga Country Club areas. Projects covering 12–20 windows with premium energy packages are typical. Single window installation starts at approximately $620.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Moraga?
faq.answer: Yes. Moraga requires a building permit for window replacements administered through Contra Costa County Building Inspection. Our team manages all permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Moraga?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Moraga commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Moraga?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Moraga replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Moraga?
faq.answer: Most Moraga projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
